description: Looks up a credit union member by member ID and returns the current balance of their savings account. Read-only; never changes data.
goal: Look up the member {{inputs.member_id}} and read the current balance of their savings account in USD.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Member ID: M- followed by 5 or 6 digits

outputs.name: account_type
outputs.description: Type of the account the balance belongs to

outputs.name: balance
outputs.description: Current balance of the savings account
